Patch notes
v2.0Current version

Version pattern: X.Y.Z · X major update · Y minor update · Z bug fixes

Fixed bugs

  • Improved the To-Do List UI and task flow.
  • Fixed the All Grades dashboard showing Grade 8 instead of the selected grade.
  • Fixed the mobile side panel so it starts collapsed instead of appearing across the top.
  • Fixed Calendar Year View in Galaxy and Blue themes, including correctly aligned weekday labels.

New features and changes

  • Renamed Normal Theme to Blue Theme.
  • Made Galaxy Theme the default theme.
  • Added Mathematics solutions for A Square and A Cube.
  • Added Mathematics solutions for Power Play.
  • Added Bookmarks so questions can be saved for later.
  • Removed Light Mode.

Found a bug, have a suggestion, or have a question? Send it through the Feedback section.
